questions.question: In the year 1952, who among the following lent his voice for the film ‘Amar Bhupali’, which was being produced in two languages simultaneously and he sang in both Bengali and Marathi ?
questions.solution:
Manna Dey, the versatile playback singer, lent his voice for the film Amar Bhupali (1952) in both Bengali and Marathi. Directed by V. Shantaram, the film was a biopic of the Marathi poet and musician Honaji Bala.

Note: Manna Dey was renowned for his classical training and the ability to sing complex compositions across multiple Indian languages.

questions.question: Which state government honoured Vani Jairam with the MS Subbulakshmi Award for 2019?
questions.solution:
The Tamil Nadu government honored the legendary playback singer Vani Jairam with the MS Subbulakshmi Award for 2019.

Legacy: Known as the 'Nightingale of South India', Vani Jairam had a prolific career spanning over five decades, singing in more than 19 Indian languages and winning three National Film Awards.

questions.question: Who among the following is/was a famous sitarist?
questions.solution:
Pandit Ravi Shankar was a world-renowned Sitar virtuoso and composer. He became a global cultural ambassador, bringing Indian classical music to the Western world through his performances and collaborations.

Quick Check: Zakir Hussain plays Tabla, Bismillah Khan played Shehnai, and Bhimsen Joshi was a classical vocalist.

questions.question: Lata Mangeshkar was honoured with the Bharat Ratna in the year ________.
questions.solution:
Lata Mangeshkar, widely considered one of the greatest playback singers in India, was honored with the Bharat Ratna, the nation's highest civilian award, in the year 2001.

Fact: She was the second vocalist to receive this honor, following M.S. Subbulakshmi.

questions.question: Who among the following is the first vocalist to receive the Bharat Ratna in 2008 and is also credited to have popularised 'Khyal Gayaki'?
questions.solution:
Pandit Bhimsen Joshi was the first vocalist to be awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2008. He was a master of the Kirana Gharana and played a pivotal role in popularizing Khayal Gayaki (a modern genre of classical singing) among the masses.

Note: He was also the force behind the famous Sawai Gandharva Music Festival.

questions.question: Some of the talas invented by ____________ include Trimukhi, Panchamukhi, Saptamukhi and Navamukhi.
questions.solution:
The legendary Carnatic musician M. Balamuralikrishna was a prolific composer who invented several new Talas (rhythmic cycles) including Trimukhi, Panchamukhi, Saptamukhi, and Navamukhi.

Innovation: He was also known for creating new Ragams (melodic scales) such as Mahati, Lavangi, and Sidhi, showcasing his immense creativity in the classical tradition.

questions.question: The registered office of the Sangeet Natak Akademi is at:
questions.solution:
The registered office of the Sangeet Natak Akademi is located in New Delhi (at Rabindra Bhavan).

Status: It is India's national academy for music, dance, and drama, established by the Government of India to promote and preserve the country's diverse performing arts heritage.
